name: GJ 570 A
description: A nearby orange dwarf, 74% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: radius in solar radii, 0.739 +/- 0.019, from the literature measurement the table lists

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: mass 0.743 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 570A: effective temperature in K, 4507 +/- 58, from the literature measurement the table lists

text.card: A nearby orange dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 74% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.739 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 4,507 K.
